summary: Gravel angle-parking pull-in on Witton Road, backed by bush, with houses well away.
reasons: Bush behind, homes 60 m or more

best_section.where: Pale gravel angle-parking bay on the north side of Witton Road, opposite the river-side bush, east of the canoe club

drivers.seclusion: Bush on both sides. Nearest dwelling is 60 m (at 99 m) and across trees; the canoe club is a non-residential building 6 m from the kerb at 37 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Gravel surface meets the road edge with room for angled bays, and cars sit on it in QLD. The south kerb itself is trees to the edge, so it has no room.
drivers.traffic: Narrow road to the canoe club and the river walkway; light traffic.
drivers.convention: 4P Angle sign marks the bays as parking, and cars are parked there in QLD and Esri images.

flags: Sign is 4P Angle; time limit may matter overnight
Low-lying: 6 to 9 m, Witton Creek 21 m away
Gradient up to 17% in one 5 m step near 60 m; section itself about 4%
Gravel is across the road from the candidate kerb line
sun_shade: Open gravel with dense tree shade to the north and south; morning sun comes through from the east.
